title: The kbmon mod takes a first reading with a not-read suffix as its baseline, so the entries of the panel that comes back later are told as new although they waited all along
goal: the kbmon mod makes the first complete reading its baseline and tells nothing for it, as it does for a session whose first reading is complete
notes: Found by the review of SP-rin4kkoj (2026-10-24, S3). register.tsx notifyNeeds sets lastNeeds from the first reading whatever its suffix; a first line `nothing; not read: host` is then followed by `disk 9.4% free` and the mod notifies. Fix: hold the baseline until a complete line, and say so in kb/_self/monitoring.md (The notification).
